findings.rule: References should be numbered sequentially as they appear in the text, tables and figure legends.
findings.problem: Eight references ([3], [5], [6], [7], [9], [10], [11], [12]) are listed in the reference list but are never cited anywhere in the text, tables, or figure legends. Only [1], [2], [4], and [8] are actually cited in the manuscript body. The reference list therefore contains entries that do not correspond to any in-text citation, and the numbering is not sequential with respect to first appearance.

findings.rule: When the Reference has a Digital Object Identifier (DOI), it should be added by its URL. The instruction's own example for this exact article (Itoh et al., Nature, in press) includes the DOI https://doi.org/10.1038/nature02212.
findings.problem: Reference [11] (Itoh, H., Takahashi, A., Adachi, K., Noji, H., Yasuda, R., Yoshida, M., et al. Mechanically driven ATP synthesis by F1-ATPase. Nature (in press).) is missing its DOI URL, whereas the instruction's model example for the same article explicitly includes 'https://doi.org/10.1038/nature02212'.

findings.rule: The required section order is: … Data availability, (A comment about deposition to a preprint server…), Acknowledgements and References, arranged in this order.
findings.problem: The preprint-server comment ('A preliminary version of this work was deposited in bioRxiv … on 4 March 2026.') is embedded as a paragraph inside the Data availability section rather than appearing as a separate, distinct item between Data availability and Acknowledgements as the instruction's section-order list specifies.
